prior_coverage: Most of this family was already swept, and I have not reopened any of those verdicts without new evidence. (1) The 4.9 plugin-ecosystems group ran 8 scouts: chrome, figma, notion, obsidian-raycast, shopify, wordpress, ide-plugins (JetBrains/VS Code) and chat-app-directories (Slack/Discord/Telegram). Only WordPress.org with a paid Pro tier survived, audited down to ₪0-200/month (docs/REJECTED.md:685-731). Obsidian was rejected on a measured listing cohort: the newest plugins have a median of 27 users (research/colony-sweep/groups/plugin-ecosystems.md:61-80,150). Chrome is dead: the portfolio is banned outright and a single extension is ranked by install count (REJECTED.md:272-273). Figma is dead on discovery (REJECTED.md:287). Raycast, Discord and Figma sellers are rejected (docs/INCOME_PLAN.he.md:267; REJECTED.md:1389-1391). VS Code has no commerce (scouts/plugin-ecosystems--ide-plugins.md §7). The dev-extensions line was killed (REJECTED.md:1254-1261). (2) Shopify is parked: payouts to Israel UNKNOWN, Payoneer reportedly not accepted, selfie KYC (REJECTED.md:295-298,1399; INCOME_PLAN.he.md:267). A third-party copy also cites a $19 registration fee, which fails the ₪0 rule (scouts/plugin-ecosystems--shopify-apps.md:40). (3) Atlassian was killed on a support-response SLA, snippet grade (research/colony-sweep/SWEEP-2.md:303). monday.com ranks apps on ratings, snippet grade (SWEEP-2.md:304). HubSpot requires 3 active installs before it will list an app (groups/distribution.md:163). Slack requires 5 installed workspaces (scouts/plugin-ecosystems--chat-app-directories.md:124). (4) Wix App Market is board candidate 11, NEEDS_MORE after tick 3 (research/measurements/wix-app-market.md; logs/CHANNEL_LOOP.md:124). Freemius has been rendered as a usable Israeli rail (research/measurements/freemius-rail.md §12-14). A paid Odoo PCN874 module was killed (research/colony-sweep/screen-2/odoo-il-vat.md). (5) Never covered before this run: Firefox AMO and Edge Add-ons (the chrome-extensions scout says at line 200 that it did not search them), Google Workspace Marketplace, Microsoft AppSource, Zendesk and Canva apps. New evidence from this run: AMO's API creates listed add-ons, its policies allow paid features if disclosed, its ranking weights users by log2p(average_daily_users), its UI has no Newest sort, and a code search found no trader-identity display (all github). Edge registration is free, but a new product can only be created in Partner Center (github). JetBrains says the first plugin upload must be done by hand (github). Payoneer requires a face scan for Israeli residents (snippet), which kills the monday.com payout rail. Two seeds I dropped from the list, with this run's evidence: Zendesk paid apps require the developer's own connected Stripe account and Stripe Tax registration (snippet, https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/marketplace/publishing-to-the-marketplace/set-up-paid-app-or-theme/). Under the brief's rail rule (Stripe does not onboard Israeli accounts) that rail fails, so Zendesk is DEAD. Canva's only native monetization is a Premium Apps Program for 'eligible developers' paid under 'individual program agreements' (snippet, https://www.canva.com/developers/premium-apps-program/). That is an invited, negotiated programme, so Canva is DEAD. Its external-billing rules are unread (https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/monetization/). Microsoft AppSource was not examined for lack of search budget, so its gates are UNKNOWN (no evidence).

candidates.discovery_needs_prior_sale: UNKNOWN. The ranking inputs are unread. The Verified badge needs 60+ days live and 40+ live installs on premium sites (faq.html:64). candidates.estimate_basis: INFERENCE; no Wix sales data is rendered. Assume $5-15/site/month and 0-10 paying sites across 2-5 apps by month 12. That is $0-150 gross, 100% to us in year one minus 2.5% (faq.txt:130), about ₪0-550. Base rates for new listings on install-ranked stores: the newest Obsidian cohort has a median of 27 users (groups/plugin-ecosystems.md:61-67), and paid Odoo localization modules have a median of 1 lifetime purchase (screen-2/odoo-il-vat.md:18). Cash lags: nothing pays out until $200 (about ₪740) accumulates, and money earned in month M arrives in M+2 (faq.txt:134,138). Month-12 cash can therefore be ₪0 even when sales exist.
candidates.time_to_first_sale: 3-6 months after the owner step: build takes 2-4 weeks, the AI review takes minutes, then discovery. The first payout comes only after $200 has accumulated.

(a) AMO's own search code weights users by field_value_factor(average_daily_users, log2p) times a ranking_bump (mozilla/addons-server src/olympia/search/filters.py). gate_buyer_supply.evidence: AMO brings users, not buyers: it has no checkout. Default browse sorts by recommended status, then users. The UI offers Relevance, Recently Updated, Most Users, Top Rated and Trending, with no Newest (mozilla/addons-frontend SearchFilters). No user numbers were read: addons.mozilla.org was EGRESS_BLOCKED this session.

candidates.discovery_needs_prior_sale: No sale gate, since payment is off-platform. Discovery does need prior users: score = relevance × log2p(average_daily_users), with a 4.0 weight for approved non-experimental add-ons. A new add-on scores about 1 against about 13.3 at 10,000 users, a roughly 13× handicap. That is milder than JetBrains' zero multiplier, and there is no Newest sort.
candidates.owner_step: Proposed step 8: create a Mozilla account on the brand mailbox with TOTP 2FA and generate AMO API credentials into a GitHub secret. The payout reuses step 3 (Gumroad). The Distribution Agreement requires 'reasonable technical support' with contact information and no stated SLA; an agent-run written channel would handle it (AMBER).
candidates.estimate_basis: INFERENCE; no AMO cohort was measured. The closest analog is the newest Obsidian cohort: median 27 users, p90 94 (groups/plugin-ecosystems.md:61-67). One VS Code author reported about $99 in donations for 100+ hours of work at about 1,000 new monthly users (ide-plugins scout §7). Assume 5-10 add-ons × 50-300 users each × 1-3% conversion × a $5-9 one-time licence, with Gumroad taking about 22% at $9 (rails.ts:81). That gives ₪0-400/month by month 12.
candidates.time_to_first_sale: 2-6 months after the first listings; for any single add-on, plausibly never.
